description: Prepare managing a partner vault: its name, pause, automatic funding, priority fee ceiling, fee recipient, risk limits (a lower cap or higher floor applies at once; a looser one waits three hours, then apply), buying running loans, its tokens, and a running loan listed for sale, each field one transaction; what the vault has already is left out. For the vault's manager alone, read from the chain, no gage service asked. A manager cannot withdraw depositors' assets; a fee recipient other than the wallet takes fees not yet claimed too, and a loan listed for sale can sell for as little as book value plus half of what it has still to earn, which depositors bear. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

addTokens.description: Tokens to lend against, of its universe: each waits three hours, then applyTokens

apply.description: Changes whose three hours are over, by the field that made them: they apply now

applyTokens.description: Tokens added whose three hours are over: they lend from now

buyLoans.description: Whether it buys running loans. Stopping, or asking more, applies at once; starting, or asking less, waits three hours

extraBps.description: The extra return a year asked above the model's, bps; the one set now when omitted

cancelListing.description: Takes a loan of the vault off sale

cashKeptFreeBps.description: The share of the vault a new loan must leave free in cash, bps. Higher applies at once, lower waits three hours

drop.description: Changes still waiting, by the field that made them: dropped

dropTokens.description: Tokens added and still waiting: dropped

feeRecipient.description: Where the manager's share of the performance fee is paid, what is not yet claimed included; not the vault itself. In mixed case, its checksum must hold

fillersOpen.description: Whether gage's automatic funding may fund loans within the vault's mandate; open loans are untouched either way

listLoan.description: Lists a running loan of the vault for sale to other vaults; mandate 13. Its price falls in about five minutes to book value plus half of what it has still to earn, and what a sale gives up, the vault's depositors bear

hours.description: How long it stays for sale, in hours, at most to the loan's end; 24 when omitted

maxLoan.description: The most it puts into one loan, raw units of its asset. Lower applies at once, higher waits three hours

maxPerTokenBps.description: The most of the vault lent against one token, bps. Lower applies at once, higher waits three hours

minRateGrade.description: The lowest Loan grade it funds, 0 (any) to 4 (A). Higher applies at once, lower waits three hours

name.description: A new name, as depositors see it: 1 to 48 bytes, no control or invisible characters

paused.description: true pauses new investment (deposits, funding and loan sales); withdrawals go on. false resumes it

priorityFeeBps.description: The most it pays the protocol for a loan, bps of its profit, 0 to 5000; applies at once, up or down

removeTokens.description: Tokens to stop lending against, at once; open loans run on

stockBps.description: The most of the vault lent against stocks, bps; a category outside its universe stays closed. Lower applies at once, higher waits three hours

vault.description: A partner vault this wallet manages

wallet.description: The vault's manager: the one wallet its curator's calls take

name: gage_prepare_vault_manage
title: Prepare: Manage a partner vault
